purpose: Occupy a known amount of context and generate a token or two, so device memory can be read at that context length without the answer mattering.

passage.description: Filler text sized to the context length under test. Its content is irrelevant; only the KV cache it fills is measured.

instruction.description: What to do with the passage. Always asks for a very short answer, so decode contributes as little as possible to the memory reading.

expectations: Any text. This prompt measures what a context costs in device memory, never whether the answer is right.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.memory_kv needs one prompt record so its observed context slope has a real prompt subset hash from the first measured run.
